faqs.question: What is AKGEC Skills Foundation?
questionVariants: What is AKGEC Skills Foundation?
Tell me about AKGEC Skills Foundation.
faqs.answer: AKGEC Skills Foundation (ASF) is the skill-development initiative of Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College. It is supported by the National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and focuses on industry-oriented training in robotics, automation and advanced manufacturing.
